youtube_description:
Space, stars, celestial bodies are all very fascinating subjects for students and everyone else alike. Students from Sevasadan English medium school asked questions to IISER Pune Scientists about astronomy. Through this interactive session, they learnt various concepts in astronomy and got their questions answered by the experts in the field. Watch this video to know more about stars, planets, back holes and the universe in general as a question answer session.

Team: Ashok Rupner, Vivek Kannadi, Shraddha Bhurkunde, Parmeshwar Sigh Yadav, Shanti Pise, Vaishali Chaudhari, Chaitanya Mungi, Students of Sevasadan English medium school Pune.
